description: Start a background job that compiles a saved flow (or bundle) into a Playwright .flow.ts/.spec.ts and verifies it (readiness: clean runs). With a reset command (sitelooper.config.json resetCommand) it first converges, re-recording failing steps with the model. Readiness needs a reset command or fixture_isolation. Returns a job_id at once: poll job_status until done/failed (minutes).

converge.description: true = --converge (default rounds), N = --converge N rounds, false = --no-converge (compile and readiness only).

cwd.description: Project directory (absolute) the command runs in; sitelooper.config.json is found from here. Default: the server's working directory.

fixture_isolation.description: Declare that project fixtures prepare fresh data (--fixture-isolation).

vars.description: Flow variables, passed as repeated --var k=v. "{n}" in a value is replaced per run with a fresh value. Never a secret: use {{env:NAME}} markers in instructions instead.

name: build_start
